selection_basis: Explicit user selection of two leads and two contrasting mechanisms after broad screening and literature review.
comparison_question: Which evidence supports downstream mitigation of aneuploidy-associated stress versus preservation or restoration of useful BUBR1 function?

candidates.mechanism: Reduce protein aggregation and the resulting cellular stress associated with aneuploidy.
candidates.comparison_endpoint: Protein aggregation, stress burden and retained cellular function.
candidates.inference_to_examine: Protein-homeostasis effects reported in constitutional trisomy also address relevant stress in BUB1B-associated mosaic aneuploidy.
candidates.prediction_boundary: The mitigation rationale weakens if proteotoxic stress is negligible or relief preserves abnormal clones without improving useful function.
candidates.identity_note: Use sodium 4-phenylbutyrate. The public phenylbutyrate signature has parent-family support; its experimental salt and lot remain unresolved.

candidates.mechanism: Supply NAD+ to support SIRT2-dependent preservation of useful residual BUBR1 protein.
candidates.comparison_endpoint: Useful residual BUBR1 abundance and checkpoint function.
candidates.inference_to_examine: Niacin-induced NAD+ changes can engage the BUBR1 stabilization pathway shown in separate studies.
candidates.prediction_boundary: The restoration rationale weakens when useful residual protein approaches zero or NAD+ availability is nonlimiting.
candidates.identity_note: Nicotinic acid is distinct from nicotinamide. The current nomination uses a prescription extended-release formulation; its NAD+ response is not assumed identical to the cited human study.

candidates.mechanism: Support mitochondrial function through PPAR-gamma / PGC-1alpha-associated remodeling.
candidates.comparison_endpoint: Mitochondrial function and energy-related cellular stress.
candidates.inference_to_examine: Mitochondrial effects reported in trisomy-21 fibroblasts extend beyond chromosome-21-specific biology.
candidates.prediction_boundary: The rationale weakens if the observed rescue depends entirely on chromosome-21-specific mechanisms.
candidates.identity_note: The medicinal record is pioglitazone hydrochloride; public signature evidence is retained under the parent compound name.

candidates.mechanism: Permit premature-stop readthrough and production of a longer, potentially functional BUBR1 protein.
candidates.comparison_endpoint: Functional full-length or longer BUBR1 production and checkpoint function.
candidates.inference_to_examine: Readthrough demonstrated in other disease contexts can generate useful BUBR1 products from the local stop context.
candidates.prediction_boundary: The rationale weakens with very low surviving transcript or nonfunctional readthrough products.
candidates.identity_note: Use the gentamicin medicinal mixture, with sulfate formulation specified; do not silently substitute an isolated congener.

comparison_policy.scope: Exactly these four active candidates, comprising two leads and two contrasting comparators.
comparison_policy.interpretation: Fixed candidate roles for the next analysis, not a predetermined efficacy result or a proposed combination regimen.
evaluation_dimensions: Causal mechanism and expected intervention direction
Relevance and strength of supporting model evidence
Agreement and disagreement in public computational evidence
Sensitivity to assumptions and conditions that reverse the prediction
comparison_policy.aggregation: Use mechanism-specific endpoints and report evidence layers separately. No composite efficacy score or inferred probability of benefit.
comparison_policy.signature_use: Supporting or opposing evidence; missing coverage remains missing. Generic expression reversal is not required for a post-translational or readthrough hypothesis.
comparison_policy.revision_rule: Retain this version. Revise roles or membership explicitly if new mechanism, identity or comparative evidence changes the conclusion; record the reason in a new comparison version.

supporting_evidence.other_candidate_status: Retained in the supporting comparison and full screen; outside the active four-drug analysis.
